reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 affirmatively supports it: it preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, matching the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is byte-identical to the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of probing for terms inside a non-existent covenant and are not evidence of a deviation here; the rationale correctly explains this.

The rationale appropriately notes § 12.4 (a restraint on Vendor, not Customer) as out of scope rather than double-flagging it, consistent with the no-double-flag and do-not-flag-clauses-benefiting-us guidance.
